description.zh-CN:
Resolute GNOME (Current)，由 Armbian 社区维护并为 ROCK 5 ITX 打包，适用于 Roobi 自定义源安装。
Desktop-oriented image with a full GNOME environment for everyday use.
description.en:
Resolute GNOME (Current) is an Armbian image maintained for the ROCK 5 ITX platform and packaged for Roobi.
Desktop-oriented image with a full GNOME environment for everyday use.
